subject: general
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Women, Married women, Lady doctor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e78cfd5d2922309b6f59a5ef41124e373a8e1d670d91e1effc57107820d3ff33.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08cbd5b30537ba5f45e3d7eb4c50f7db5db302c140c23834130dd6c3e1282ad9.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Women, Married Women & Lady Doctor.

**Explanation:**

Married women & Lady doctors come under the category of Women. In conclusion, married women and lady doctor are subsets of women.

Now, there is a possibility that a married woman can be a lady doctor as well or not and vice versa also holds true. In conclusion, we can say that there is an intersection between married women and lady doctor.

Option A: A lady doctor or married woman is not a woman is illogical, so it is not true.

Option B: All the married women already doctors or all the lady doctors are married is not true, hence this is incorrect.

Option C: It represents the relation correctly as per the above explanation.

Option D: A lady doctor or married woman is not a woman is illogical, so it is not true.

**Hence, the C option depicts the correct relation.**
